parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by ‘learned helplessness’ (Seligman, 1988).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe the Beck depression inventory.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain two strengths of the Beck depression inventory.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe explanations of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate explanations of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD), including a discussion of
nature versus nurture. 
Psychology and consumer behaviour

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by ‘utility theory’ in consumer decision making.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Describe system 1 (fast-type) and system 2 (slow-type) thinking of a consumer
(Shleifer, 2012).

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Explain two weaknesses of system 1 (fast-type)/system 2 (slow-type) thinking as categorised
by Shleifer, 2012.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe what psychologists have discovered about retail/leisure environmental design.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about retail/leisure environmental design,
including a discussion about self reports. 
Psychology and health

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by the ‘GAS model of stress’ (Selye, 1936).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe one questionnaire that measures stress.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Explain one similarity and one difference between one psychological measure of stress and
one physiological measure of stress.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe what psychologists have discovered about managing and controlling pain.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about managing and controlling pain, including
a discussion about practical applications of management techniques. 
Psychology and organisations

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by ‘the slow rotation theory’ of shiftwork (Pheasant, 1991).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Describe the findings of the study by Fox et al. (1987) on the use of token economies to
reduce accidents at work.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain one strength and one weakness of the study by Fox et al. (1987).

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe what psychologists have discovered about leadership styles.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about leadership styles, including a discussion
of cultural bias.
